name: Soudal
verdict: Soudal is a Belgian sealants and adhesives maker founded in 1966 by Vic Swerts and still 100% family owned. Nothing found.
note: Turnhout-based private group; co-title sponsor of AG Insurance-Soudal and Soudal Quick-Step. Rating note: family ownership documented (claim soudal-family-owned); no relevant record found.
